title: 2004 AMC 12B Problem 1
statement: At each basketball practice last week, Jenny made twice as many free throws as she made at the previous practice. At her fifth practice she made \(48\) free throws. How many free throws did she make at the first practice?

solutions.text:
Each practice she made twice the previous, so going backward we halve. From the fifth practice at \(48,\) the earlier practices had \(24,\) \(12,\) \(6,\) and \(3\) free throws.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Each practice she made half as many as the next practice
Halve \(48\) four times to reach the first practice
